title: FlexA-Mem: Budget-Adaptive Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.33274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents work in scenarios with very different memory needs. A question about past conversations needs the exact facts it names, while a multi-step task needs a trace of the steps already taken together with details that the next step cannot name. Existing memories are each designed and tested for one kind of scenario. Retrieval memories such as A-Mem miss steps that the current query does not express, summaries drop exact strings, and pairing the two fixes the split of the budget in advance. We propose FlexA-Mem, a general memory that writes each unit of history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh memory for every call. The rendered memory is a compact timeline of records plus detail that a fixed rule fits into the remaining room without an LLM call. The detail is either relevant units as raw text or excerpts or the verbatim pieces that best match the query. With one store, FlexA-Mem serves both kin

translated_title: FlexA-Mem：面向大语言模型智能体的预算自适应记忆系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.33274v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体所处的应用场景对记忆的需求差异极大。关于过往对话的提问需要其中被明确提及的确切事实，而多步任务则需要已执行步骤的轨迹，以及下一步骤无法自行指明的细节。现有的记忆系统各自只针对单一场景进行设计和测试：A-Mem 等检索式记忆会遗漏当前查询未明确表达的步骤，摘要式记忆会丢失确切的字符串，而将两者简单配对又会预先固定预算的划分方式。我们提出 FlexA-Mem——一种通用记忆系统：它将每个历史单元一次性写入不可变的存储，并在每次调用时渲染出一份全新的记忆。所渲染的记忆是一条紧凑的记录时间线，再由固定规则（无需调用 LLM）把细节填入剩余空间。这些细节要么是以原始文本或摘录形式呈现的相关单元，要么是与查询最匹配的逐字片段。凭借单一的存储，FlexA-Mem 能够同时服务于两类需求……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FlexA-Mem 提出了一种预算自适应的通用智能体记忆系统，将历史一次性写入不可变存储，并在每次调用时以固定规则渲染出“紧凑时间线+查询匹配细节”的记忆，从而同时满足精确事实检索与多步任务追踪两类不同的记忆需求。
en_tdlr: FlexA-Mem is a budget-adaptive general memory for LLM agents that writes history once into an immutable store and renders a fresh per-call memory—a compact timeline filled with query-matched verbatim details by a fixed rule—to serve both exact-fact and multi-step-trajectory memory needs.
